description: Warn if handoff files are missing or local data is in Git's index.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,runpy; d=pathlib.Path.cwd(); p=next((x/'.codex/hooks/check_handoff.py' for x in (d,*d.parents) if (x/'.codex/hooks/check_handoff.py').is_file()),None); runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__') if p else None"
hooks.commandWindows: python -c "import pathlib,runpy; d=pathlib.Path.cwd(); p=next((x/'.codex/hooks/check_handoff.py' for x in (d,*d.parents) if (x/'.codex/hooks/check_handoff.py').is_file()),None); runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__') if p else None"
